title: PackageLocalSkill
description: Canonical instruction-only Agent Skill carried inside an executable Agent Program package at `skills/<skill_id>/SKILL.md`. It is the sibling of `apxm.skill-package`, not a relaxation of it: a discovery-root skill is a standalone package that asserts `executable_package: false`, while this one is carried by an executable package and asserts `carried_by_executable_package: true`. Because it is carried, it has no independent identity or version — it names its carrier and versions with it — and its `resources` list only the extra files it carries beyond its instruction source, so that list may be empty. The shared shapes (`SkillMetadata`, `ResourceEntry`, and both `instruction_source` branches) are referenced from `apxm.skill-package` so a single definition serves both contracts.

skill_id.description: Unique within the carrying package. It is also the `skills/<skill_id>/` directory name when the instruction source is file-carried.

carrier_package_id.description: The `apxm.agent` package that carries this skill. A package-local skill states no `library_id` and no `package_version` of its own: it has no identity or lifecycle apart from its carrier.

instruction_source.description: Where this skill's instructions live, discriminated by `kind`. Exactly one branch may be given, and the two reach the artifact digest by different routes: `entry` is a package path hashed into the carrier's integrity chain, `inline` is program source already inside the source-bundle digest. Both branches are admissible here because a carried skill does have an Agent Program source bundle to be part of.

resources.description: Only the extra files this skill carries beyond its instruction source, relative to `skills/<skill_id>/`. The instruction source is stated once, in `instruction_source`, and is never repeated here — unlike a discovery-root skill, whose `resources` are its complete package inventory. A skill that carries nothing beyond its instructions states an empty list.

carried_by_executable_package.description: This skill is carried inside an executable Agent Program package. Being carried by one does not make the skill executable: `executable_artifacts` stays false, so the skill contributes instructions and ordinary resources and never a handler, artifact, or runtime selector.
